LONDON HEATHROW, UNITED KINGDOM -> BANGALORE ACC INBLR4, India | HS 73201011 | BOL 7649766"). No outbound (India -> destination) bill of lading with date, destination and B/L number was visible on any accessible free source. Counter check: page header claims "Total Shipments 113 Records detected" / "Trading Partners 1" / "Ports 2", but only 5 shipment rows were actually rendered and all 5 are imports; the 'Trading Partners 1' counter contradicts the 5 distinct suppliers listed (VDL Weweler-Colaert, GME Motor Engineers, Hebei CEG, Shandong Sendtech), so the counters are unreliable.
note: No export shipment record (date + destination + HS + B/L) could be confirmed: ImportKey free view exposes only import-side rows for this entity, and the export-side aggregators (volza.com, eximpedia.app, trademo.com, importgenius.com) all returned HTTP 403 / JS-challenge, so their free views were unreadable. Slug variants tried: 'lamina-suspension-products-limited' (113 records, imports only), 'lamina-suspension-products-ltd' (no rows rendered), 'lamina-suspension-products-pvt-ltd' (no rows rendered). Company website laminasuspension.com timed out; registry pages (zaubacorp, thecompanycheck) returned 403, so no GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender or annual-report split could be read. Domestic supply evidence: not found in accessible sources — this is a data-access gap, not proof of absence. Declared HS 732010 (leaf springs for motor vehicles) is consistent with the imported/exported product description 'LEAF SPRINGS FOR MOTOR VEHICLES (MADE FROM SPRING STEEL FLATS)' seen at HS 73201011, so no HS correction is indicated. Revenue and export volume: null (not public in accessible sources). No rejection grounds found (entity appears active in customs data as recently as 2026-02-20).
